Weiner) submitted bills to American Transit Insurance Company (whose identity rests on the name alone) [e12][a8][a14][a32][a34]. Marvin Moy ceded actual control of Rutland to Pierre [a29]. Attorneys Pursuing Collections: A group known as the 'No-Fault Attorneys' prosecuted collection actions against American Transit on behalf of Rutland and Nexray [a24][p4]. This group consisted of the Law Office of Jason Tenenbaum, P.C., its principal Jason Tenenbaum, affiliated attorney Roman Kravchenko, and the Russel Friedman Law Group, LLP [a20][a21][a22][a23][p4].
